candidate_relations.reason: The clinical record supports drug-induced lupus: recurrent exudative lymphocyte-predominant pleural effusions developing after RIPE initiation, positive ANA (1:160 speckled) with negative antihistone antibody (consistent with drug-induced lupus from non-hydralazine/procainamide agents), low complement (CH50 10), negative TB cultures and negative QuantiFERON, and no granulomata on pleural biopsy. C001 names the same entity (drug-induced lupus erythematosus) and correctly attributes it to RIPE, which is the causative agent identified in the record. The added etiologic specificity does not conflict with the reference; it is a harmless and accurate elaboration.
